scope.basis: All asset references and classification names are frozen from the first-read design bytes; end reread is only a change check.

method.alphaMode: RGBA conversion; source RGB images therefore measure alpha 255
method.regionCoordinates: source pixel XYWH; absent region means the full actual image
method.tightBBox: nonzero alpha (>0), not visible-ink or crop policy
method.classification: semantic names/roles plus manual image review where needed; opaque UI surfaces/scenes/photos are not icon failures
method.flags: Only standalone icon/sprite regions with no transparent pixels (alphaMin>0) or all four region corners alpha=255; intentional surfaces/scenes/photos are not failures.
method.excluded: appearance data, generated CSS/shape backgrounds, source-byte edits, masks, browser/runtime compositing, unreferenced assets, other projects
method.viewNote: Image topArchHeight and nine-slice/runtime compositing can clip displayed edges; raw registered source/region alpha is reported separately and is not an alpha hit-test claim.
